_comment: Copy-paste MCP configurations for connecting to the KarMCP server. Pick the one that matches your client and environment. The Connection tab in the admin generates these filled in with your own site URL and credentials.

claude_desktop_local_wpcli._description: Claude Desktop — local WordPress via WP-CLI (fastest, recommended for local dev)

claude_desktop_remote_mcp_remote._description: Claude Desktop — remote WordPress via mcp-remote (recommended for remote/shared hosting)
claude_desktop_remote_mcp_remote._note: mcp-remote is a published, general-purpose stdio-to-HTTP bridge. It runs as a LOCAL subprocess on the machine with Claude Desktop, so it needs Node.js 18+ locally. KarMCP publishes no npm package of its own.

claude_desktop_remote_bundled_proxy._description: Claude Desktop — remote WordPress via the bundled proxy file
claude_desktop_remote_bundled_proxy._note: Claude Desktop launches the proxy locally, so mcp-proxy.mjs must exist on THIS machine, not on the server. Extract bin/mcp-proxy.mjs from the plugin ZIP, save it locally, and point 'args' at that path. Re-extract after plugin updates to pick up proxy fixes. Set KARMCP_SITES instead of WP_URL to drive several sites from one connection.

env.WP_APP_PASSWORD: xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx

claude_code_mcp_json._description: Claude Code — place as .mcp.json in project root

claude_code_remote_http._description: Claude Code — remote WordPress over direct HTTP

vscode_mcp_direct_http._description: VS Code MCP extension — direct HTTP connection (add to VS Code settings)

mcp_inspector_wpcli._description: MCP Inspector — test and debug tools via WP-CLI

mcp_inspector_proxy._description: MCP Inspector — test and debug tools through the bundled proxy
mcp_inspector_proxy._command: npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector -e WP_URL=https://your-site.com -e WP_USERNAME=admin -e WP_APP_PASSWORD=xxxx node bin/mcp-proxy.mjs
